what: Every digest of a Figure Statement this publisher has issued, per figure, oldest first. The last entry is the statement in force. Entries are only ever added.
digest_rule: SHA-256 over the COSE Sig_structure ["Signature1", protected, h'', payload] of the statement (the ToBeSigned scheme); lowercase hex
chain_note: previous_sha256 is the SHA-256 of this file as it stood at the previous sequence number; every version is signed and recorded in the Sigstore Rekor log (bundle beside this file) and kept in the repository history.
test_vectors_note: Test Subjects, not published figures: statements issued in order by the same key so that the superseded state can be checked. See /spec/ietf/vectors/.

metro-gap-fort-wayne-in-2025.note: Signed and served at about 08:27 UTC on 2026-11-25 without its limits member: the read of the contract file failed and the statement was built without it. Found by an independent reader (K. Gruszka, proofbundle). Value, source and claim were the same as in the statement in force. Since the fix of the same day the service issues no statement when a file it is built from cannot be read.
